people.imagined: A karst cave mouth at dusk. She has stopped on the threshold of an abode wall covered in old brush-strokes and tilts her head as if the wall had spoken. A silver needle holds her hair, and her pleasant face is entirely calm.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a cave mouth at dusk, she turns her head a little to listen to a wall off-frame, a pleasant face quite calm. Face: a tall woman's long, quiet, pleasant face with soft features, a gentle full mouth in a small kind smile, smooth pale skin, large dark attentive eyes, straight even brows, a high forehead; nothing in the face is cruel, which is the point. Hair: glossy black, coiled up high and held by one long silver needle with a plain round head, thrust through the coil. Body: tall, straight, slender, hands folded; a patient stillness. Clothing: a long robe of silk in a dark red that has aged to the colour of old liver, brownish-crimson, cross-collared, with wide sleeves and a plain matching sash, immaculate and heavy, perhaps three layers with each edge slightly different in shade. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front of her waist, slim, with short clean nails; a silver ring with a plain flat top on the right forefinger. Background: grey karst rock, a mouth of a cave, drifting dusk haze, blurred. Light: low cool dusk light from the upper left, a faint warm red from her robe on her chin. Expression: courteous calm, listening. A very faint dark teal-blue Water-and-shadow hint round her hands. Palette: liver red, silver, grey stone.

people.imagined: The night in the year 700, in his study: a fine copyist's son with a thin brush in his hand, his master's cut hair in a bundle on the desk. He is perfectly composed, and has just finished binding hair into the brush.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A fastidious scholar sits at a writing desk holding up a long thin brush, examining its tip with cool satisfaction. Face: a long, refined, pale face with a high forehead, a long thin nose, thin lips pressed in a small, patient smile, deep-set dark eyes with an unwavering, courteous gaze, thin well-groomed brows, a thin trimmed black beard on the chin; about fifty. Hair: black, combed tight, in a neat high topknot in a black lacquer cap. Body: slender, straight-backed, long neck, elegant stillness. Clothing: a fine scholar's robe of black silk with a high collar and dark-red lining at the cuffs and collar edge, wide sleeves, a sash of dark red cord; every fold perfect. Hands and objects: in his right hand a long thin brush with a long grey hair tip, held vertically; on the desk a small dark ink stone, a bundle of long white hair tied with red thread, and a shallow bowl of dark red liquid; a single silver needle laid across the desk. Background: dark study shelves with unmarked scrolls, blurred. Light: a single lamp from the upper left, warm, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: calm, fastidious, patient, unsettling. A faint dark crimson hint along the brush. Palette: black, dark red, aged yellow.

people.imagined: At the mouth of U Lan Cốc in the small hours, a clay lamp burning on a ledge for the children. She has just stepped out to look at it and speaks softly, as if someone in the next room were asleep.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of a gorge in the small hours, she stands beside a small clay lamp on a rock ledge and speaks in a hush, a finger half raised to her lips. Face: a thin, quiet, tired face with high cheekbones, pale skin, large soft grey eyes with shadows under them, thin level brows, a straight nose, a gentle mouth that is nearly always in a half-smile of attention; about forty. Hair: dark brown, thick, in a loose low braid with a few grey strands, a grey ribbon. Body: thin, narrow, shoulders drawn slightly in, a gentle stoop. Clothing: a plain grey robe of fine woven cloth, stained a deep grey at the cuffs with years of ground ink but clean, a cross collar, long sleeves, a plain sash; a pale stone with a tiny flower fossil on a thin cord at her throat. Hands and objects: ink-grey fingertips, clearly visible, one hand raised; a small clay lamp with a steady yellow flame on the ledge beside her; the pale stone pendant at the throat. Background: dark limestone gorge walls, wet moss, a faint pale orchid on the rock, blurred. Light: the small warm lamp from the lower right, cool grey dark elsewhere. Expression: soft, watchful, protective. A faint violet-blue shade round the lamp. Palette: grey, lamp amber, deep teal.

people.imagined: A wind-bitten rock ledge on Hắc Ưng Peak, dusk. He sits with a heavy sabre across his knees, having just watched a climber turn back, waiting without any hurry for the next, the corners of his beard stained rust brown.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a bare rock ledge, a heavy sabre across his knees, he watches the path in silence. Face (most important: the rust-stained beard corners): a broad, heavy-jawed grey man's face, deep furrows, a thick flattened nose, small hard grey eyes under heavy brows, a thick grey beard whose corners at the mouth are stained a dull rust brown; about fifty-five. Hair: iron grey, long, tied tight at the nape with a strip of black leather. Body: broad, thick-shouldered, heavy-chested, a sitting bulk like a boulder. Clothing: a long coat of dark brown leather-trimmed wool with a high collar and wide cuffs, well made and clean, worn over black trousers; a plain black belt; an iron-grey scarf. Hands and objects: both big scarred hands rest on a heavy single-edged sabre in a plain black scabbard with an iron guard, laid across his knees; the right thumb on the guard. Background: a wind-scoured cliff of dark red-brown rock, an eagle shape far off in a pale sky, blurred. Light: cold low light from the upper left, a rust glow on the rock. Expression: flat, patient, unhurried, a mouth that might smile. A faint red-brown iron glint on the blade. Palette: iron grey, rust brown, cold sky.

people.imagined: A dry riverbed town at noon. He holds his gourd at his side and does not drink, because a villager is watching the well. He turns his whole body so that no one sees him lift it.
people.subject: The moment: at a village well he stands with his gourd held down at his side, deliberately not drinking, glancing at the unseen people watching. Face: a dry, tidy old man's face, narrow, sun-leathered, deep vertical lines in the cheeks, thin lips pressed, small sharp dark eyes, thin grey brows; a neat close-trimmed grey beard; about sixty-five. Hair: thin white-grey, tied up neatly under a small black cloth cap. Body: lean, upright, dry, stiff. Clothing: a clean, well-pressed robe of fine brown-grey cotton, long, cross collar with a pale edge, narrow sleeves, a neat dark sash; a travelling cloak folded on one arm. Hands and objects: a small round gourd on a cord, stoppered with wood, bitter-brown, held in the right hand against his hip; his left hand on the stone rim of a dry stone well. Background: a stone well with a rope, a dusty village lane with low houses, blurred. Light: hard white noon from the upper left, a short shadow. His shadow lies sharp and short beside the well curb, and the gourd's bitter brown glints dully. Expression: patient, watchful, utterly composed with a hint of old grievance. A faint dark-teal Water hint in the well's shadow. Palette: brown-grey, stone, dull green.

people.imagined: Dawn, the last well of Tình Sa. She stands at the lip with a bundle of bitter-root tied to her chest, a young woman looking down into the dark water, afraid and not turning back.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. At a well's stone lip, a young woman looks down into the dark with a bundle of root tied to her chest. Face: a young, plain, brave face, a square jaw, strong brows drawn together, dark steady eyes, a straight nose, lips pressed tight in fear and resolve; about twenty-seven. Hair: black, in a single plain braid pinned up and a strip of white cloth tied round the head. Body: sturdy, strong-armed, a well-keeper's frame, upright. Clothing: a plain, clean robe of undyed linen with a rope belt and rolled sleeves, a coarse hemp apron; across her chest a bundle of long knotted dried roots, tied with cord, bitter brown. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the rough stone lip of a well; a rope and a bucket beside; roots hanging at her chest. Her knuckles are white on the stone, a loose lock of hair lifts in the draught from the well, and dawn has just turned the water below to a thread of pewter. Background: a round stone well and a river village at dawn, blurred. Light: pale grey dawn light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: afraid, stubborn, compassionate. A faint green-brown bitter Wood hint in the roots. Palette: faded grey, root brown, pale green.

people.imagined: A road between the sects in the year he taught his one student. A wandering man with a pack on his back sits on a stone, quite proud, a small brush in his hand, writing out a talisman for someone who will pay.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A wandering talisman writer sits on a roadside stone with a travelling desk on his knee, a brush lifted, smiling with pride at the page. Face: a thin, lively, weathered face, long and brown, deep laugh lines, bright dark eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long straight nose, a wide mouth smiling, a thin white beard; about fifty-eight. Hair: grey, long, tied in a loose topknot with a strip of blue cloth, a few strands blowing. Body: lean, wiry, a little bent from the road. Clothing: a long robe of blue-grey cotton, dusty at the hem but clean and neatly cut, a rough travelling cloak, a cord belt with gourds; a straw hat on his back. Hands and objects: a brush with a long grey tip in the right hand, a small portable writing board on the left knee with a strip of blank yellow paper, a small ink pot; a bag of paper strips at his side. Background: a dusty road and a distant range, blurred. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: proud, trusting, pleased. A faint red hint of cinnabar at the brush. Palette: faded blue-grey, yellow paper, brown.

people.imagined: A river landing in the morning. A gold-washer's pan on his back, he waits for his master to speak, three letters sewn into his coat, hoping for once to be asked to sit down.
people.subject: The moment: at a river landing he stands with hands clasped, patiently waiting to be spoken to, a shallow gold-washer's pan on his back. Face: a sunburned river man's open, honest face with high cheeks, narrow dark eyes crinkled by squinting, a straight nose peeling at the tip, a wide mouth that wants to smile, a light stubble; about thirty-five. Hair: black, short, tied with a band of red cloth. Body: strong, lean, easy-moving, shoulders squared, a boatman's balance. Clothing: a coat of dark blue-green canvas with a stiff collar, clean, three white paper corners of letters showing at the lapel where they are sewn in, a leather belt; trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet. Hands and objects: a wide shallow iron pan hung across the back by a strap, its rim visible over both shoulders; hands clasped before him, with a small silver ring. The sun gilds the stubble on his jaw, a strip of reed is caught in the strap of the pan, and a heron stands in the shallows behind him. Background: a wide brown river and reeds, a landing stage, a low sun, blurred. Light: low gold morning light from the upper left, glitter on water. Expression: patient, hopeful, loyal. A faint pale blue Water hint at his hands. Palette: river brown, blue-green, gold.

people.imagined: Night at the gorge. She cannot sit still. She stands at the edge of the lamplight with heavy-lidded eyes that are never tired, looking south, thinking of the Tower, restless and not yet ashamed.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of lamplight at night, restless, she looks away over her shoulder toward the south. Face (most important: heavy-lidded, never-tired eyes): a sharp, raftsman's-daughter's face, sun-brown, with prominent cheekbones, heavy-lidded dark eyes that never seem tired and never seem to rest, a small straight nose, a firm mouth with a tiny curl of impatience; about thirty-five. Hair: black, in a thick high ponytail tied with a cord, a few loose strands across the face. Body: wiry, restless, weight on the balls of the feet. Her weight rests on the balls of her feet, shoulders a little forward, as if ready to walk off at any moment. Clothing: a close-fitting dark robe of grey-green fine cloth, narrow sleeves, high collar, a belt of braided cord, neat. Hands and objects: a long silver needle held between two fingers, point down; in her sleeve the corner of a woven raft-rope bracelet. The silver needle is thin as a hair and as long as her hand; her left hand holds a coil of raft-rope bracelet and keeps twisting it. Background: Behind her a thin string of small clay lamps along the gorge floor, a rope ladder hanging from a ledge, and far above a thin strip of stars. Light: faint cool starlight from the upper left, the lamp's warm edge on one cheek. A thread of pale blue moonlight picks out her cheekbone. Expression: restless, hungry, impatient. A faint dark violet shade at her fingertips. Palette: grey-green, black, lamp amber.

people.imagined: A night in the gorge. He sits by a small lamp with a ledger of plain paper, making his nightly entry about who went out. Lime dust whitens the backs of his hands, which he never wipes.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in lamplight with a brush over a blank notebook, writing carefully, a frown on his face. Face: a plain, earnest, square face with a firm jaw, level brown eyes under straight thick brows, a broad nose, a closed honest mouth; a pale line of lime dust on one cheek; about thirty-eight. Hair: black and cropped short, a little untidy. A few grey-white flecks of lime dust powder the hair above the left ear. Body: stocky, solid, upright, a lime-burner's shoulders. He sits on a low stool with his back straight and one knee bent, elbows resting on a small board across his lap. Clothing: a clean plain robe of undyed hemp-cloth, cross collar, long sleeves rolled to the wrist, a wide cord belt; neat. Hands and objects: the backs of both hands powder-white with lime dust all the way to the wrist, plainly visible; a brush held upright; a bound notebook of plain paper on his knee, blank-looking; a pale stone pendant on a cord. Background: a dark gorge cave, a small clay lamp, blurred. Behind him the cave wall is hung with a row of small slates, each scratched with tally marks, and a bundle of dry herbs hangs from a peg. Light: a small lamp from the lower right, warm on the hands. The lamp throws his shadow huge and still on the cave roof. Expression: stubborn, earnest, tired, just. A faint ochre Earth hint on the dust. Palette: lime white, grey, lamp amber.

people.imagined: A pill stall in Tinh Hán Thành at midday. She counts coins into her palm, one ear notched where a chain caught it, and smells of iron and cloves, and has just named a higher price than yesterday.
people.subject: The moment: at a stall she counts coins from a stranger into her palm, calmly, and names a price. Face (most important: the notched left ear): a hard, pretty, weathered face with sharp cheekbones, narrow black eyes, a flat nose, a thin practical mouth, tanned skin, the left ear visibly notched with a bite-sized V cut out of its rim; about forty. Hair: black, in a tight practical braid wrapped round the head with a strip of cloth. The braid is bound with a strip of rust-red cloth, a few short strands sticking up at the crown. Body: strong, compact, shoulders broad, a hand always near the sabre. Clothing: a long, well-cut jacket of dark brown cloth trimmed with leather, a small iron mail collar visible at the neck, a red cloth sash at the waist, and black trousers; clean and hard-wearing. Hands and objects: a handful of coins in the left palm; before her on a cloth, a row of small dark-red pills in a flat box, and a short curved sword hanging at her side. Background: the stone arch of a city market and crowds, blurred. Light: bright noon from the upper left. The noon sun glints off the pills in their box like small dark gems. Expression: flat, practical, cold. A faint red-brown iron glint. Palette: rust, umber, brick.

people.imagined: On a river bank at the Hungry Ghost festival at dusk. She lifts the small green bell on her wrist and rings it once, over the water, and watches a thin thread of light go from the lamp and out across the river.
people.subject: The moment: on a river bank at dusk, her wrist lifted, she rings a small green bell once and watches the water. Face: a neat, narrow, gentle face with high cheekbones, tidy brows, clear dark eyes that follow something over the water, a small mouth just parted; a smudge of ink on one cheek; about forty. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot with a plain wooden pin. A loose strand blows across her temple and she leaves it. Body: slight, upright, neat. Clothing: a robe of fine brown-green cotton, cross collar, narrow sleeves with ink-stained cuffs, a belt of plain cord; all very neat. Hands and objects: on the right wrist a small bell of green bronze on a cord; in the left hand a black bronze lamp with nine small wick holes, glowing faintly; ink stains clear on both cuffs. Background: a wide dark river with small floating paper lanterns, blurred, a dusk sky. Light: dusk blue with small warm lantern glows from the lower left. The small lantern lights drift on the water as dots of gold and the lamp in her hand glows like a coal. Expression: devoted, solemn, tender, a little afraid. A faint pale-green and silver sound-ripple around the bell. Palette: bell green, lamp gold, dusk blue. Her breath is held, as if waiting to hear something arrive.

people.imagined: A rainy inn corner in Thu Trì Thành at night. He sits with his back to the wall facing the door, a ledger of faces open under his hand, watching every person who comes in.
people.subject: The moment: sitting with his back to a wall at night, he watches a door out of frame over the top of a closed ledger. Face: a thin, dry, pale face with a high narrow forehead, deep-set black eyes that never blink, a thin hooked nose, thin lips drawn tight, a close dark moustache; about forty-five. Hair: black, plastered flat, in a tight small knot under a black cap. The hair is so tightly combed that the comb-lines show. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, held stiff and wary. Clothing: a good, heavy rain cloak of oiled black silk with a high collar, over a dark grey robe, nicely fitted; a small brass clasp. Hands and objects: a thick small ledger bound in black with a red cord on the table, one hand flat on it; a coin held between two fingers of the other hand; a cup of tea untouched. Background: a dim inn wall of dark wood, a paper lantern, rain on the window, blurred. Light: a single lantern from the upper left, shadow below the eyes. The rain on the window throws moving grey streaks across his black cloak. Expression: suspicious, cold, patient. A faint dark teal Water hint in the rain. Palette: black, rain grey, a point of red.

people.imagined: A grove of dead trees in the swamp where each tree stands for a patient. He walks between them with his green-stained hands clasped behind his back, quite at ease, the hair of a clever old man.
people.subject: The moment: walking between leafless dead trees in a swamp grove, hands clasped behind his back, he looks up at a trunk with calm interest. Face (most important: green-stained hands): a long, thin, handsome-old face with high cheekbones, deep furrows, pale cold eyes, thin white brows, a thin proud mouth with a condescending twist, a white pointed beard; about sixty-five. Hair: white, long, in a high knot with a jade pin. Body: tall, thin, upright, hands clasped behind him with green-stained fingers showing. Clothing: a long robe of fine pale-grey silk with a green hem stained from the swamp, a stiff collar, a black sash, a loose cloak; clean and costly. Hands and objects: the clasped hands, wrists and fingers stained bright green to the knuckles, clearly visible; a small bronze censer on a chain hanging from a belt, trailing a green thread of smoke. The wet black bark of the nearest trunk shines faintly, a few green drops fall from the sleeve of his robe, and his feet make no sound in the mud. Background: grey swamp mist with rows of bare dead trees, each with a small bundle tied to a low branch, blurred. Light: cold grey diffused light from the upper left. Expression: cool, arrogant, mildly curious. A faint green-yellow Wood hint in the smoke. Palette: pale grey, poison green, black.

people.imagined: The night shrine room of a good Hòe Âm house. She stands carrying her son's lamp in both hands, one wrist bandaged. There is a hairline crack in the clay of the lamp, and she is holding it extremely gently.
people.subject: The moment: in a quiet shrine room at night, she holds a small clay lamp in both hands in front of her chest and looks down at it with a mother's devotion. Face: a pale, upright, refined face of a good family, a delicate chin, level dark eyes red at the rims with sleeplessness, fine brows, a thin mouth held steady; about thirty-eight. Hair: black, in a neat high knot with a pair of white jade pins, a thin white ribbon. Body: slender, straight, held very still. Clothing: a robe of fine pale-lilac silk with a cross collar and a white inner collar, wide sleeves, a silver-grey sash; a bandage of white cloth on the left wrist, plainly visible, with a faint stain at the edge. Hands and objects: a plain unglazed clay lamp with a single tiny flame, with a hairline crack running up its side, held in both hands; a talisman-writing brush tucked in the sash. Background: a dim shrine room with a plain wooden table, a hanging curtain, blurred. Light: the small lamp warm on her chin from below, cold blue shadow elsewhere. Expression: devoted, steady, pain held down. A faint cool blue Water hint round the lamp. Palette: lilac, white, lamp amber.

people.imagined: At the mouth of a freshly opened cave abode, in torchlight. He holds up a jade slip to read it and counts his money in his head; two fingers are missing from his left hand, and he says a cave took them.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of a cave in torchlight, he holds a jade slip up to his eyes with a greedy smile, the left hand held out. Face: a lean, foxy, stubbled face with a long nose, narrow shifting brown eyes, a sly curl to the mouth, a thin scar on the chin; about forty-five. Hair: black, greasy, tied back in a short tail with a bit of cord. A few strands of long grey-black hair hang over his forehead, tacky with sweat. Body: wiry, quick, crouched, ready to run. Clothing: a dark green dust-streaked robe of good cloth, a short travelling jacket, a leather belt with many small pouches; clean enough. Hands and objects: the left hand held up, with the last two fingers plainly missing from the knuckle; the right holding a pale green jade slip close to the face; a rolled map under his arm; a small torch smoking on the wall. Background: the black mouth of a cave in a limestone massif, dark ferns, blurred. Light: a torch from the right, orange, hard shadows. The torch flame makes the green jade slip glow like a cat's eye. Expression: a greedy, sly, absorbed smile, the eyes narrowed on the jade.  Palette: dark green, torch orange, black.

people.imagined: Dawn at the edge of a village. He has woken, once again, barefoot with fresh mud on his heels and a rope burned round one ankle, and stands gaping as if just learning where he is.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot at dawn in a field at a village edge, blinking, a length of rope still trailing from one ankle. Face: a round, soft, slow-looking young face with wide-set brown eyes half awake, a slightly open mouth, thick low brows, a mild expression; a smear of mud on one cheek; about twenty. Hair: tousled brown, a cowlick, straw stuck in it. The cowlick at the crown stands up like a tuft of grass. Body: broad-shouldered, soft, loose-limbed. His shoulders sag and one knee is slightly bent, the weight leaning toward the village as if he had not quite finished walking. Clothing: a plain robe of undyed hemp, clean, cross collar, loosely belted with a cord, sleeves a little long; bare feet. Hands and objects: a rope tied round the left ankle, the skin burned red under it, the rope end trailing on the grass; fresh mud on both heels; a small dull jade pendant on a cord. Background: a misty village with thatched roofs and a dawn sky, blurred. Behind him a thin line of houses with smoking chimneys, a low wall of stacked stones, and a lone crow on a post. Light: pale cool dawn from the upper left. A weak sun is just clearing the roofs, laying long blue shadows across the wet grass. Expression: vague, mild, puzzled. A very faint dark blue shade round the feet. Palette: dawn grey, mud brown, pale straw.

people.imagined: At the gorge lamp, in a mood. She sits on a rock with a plait that falls to her knees, and stands on its end without noticing as she teaches or refuses to teach another child, whichever she feels like.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a rock with her chin up, deciding whether to answer someone, a very long plait coiled in her lap. Face: a young, sharp, pretty face with a stubborn chin, wide dark eyes with a gleam, thin arched brows, a small mouth with a half smile of mischief; about sixteen. Hair (most important: the plait): a single black plait of astonishing length, thick as a wrist, hanging down past her knees and gathered in coils on her lap, never cut, tied with a bit of red thread. Body: small, slender, straight, a girl's quick shoulders. Clothing: a clean grey-green robe of fine cotton with a cross collar and short sleeves, a belt of cord; neat, well fitted. Hands and objects: in her hand a single silver needle; on the lap the coils of the plait; her bare foot rests on its end. Background: a dark gorge with a small lamp on a ledge, blurred. Light: warm small lamp from the lower left. The lamp light makes the red thread on the plait glow and picks out the loose fine hairs at her temples. Expression: wilful, bright, amused. A faint violet shade round the needle. Palette: black, grey-green, lamp gold. She tilts her head as if the person before her had said something quite stupid.

people.imagined: A ford at dusk, a young traveller with a letter in an oilcloth, writing a name on the back and watching the ink dance from the tremor in his thumb. He does not look at the river.
people.subject: The moment: at a ford at dusk he writes slowly on a slip of paper, his right thumb trembling so that the ink dances, with his eyes away from the water. Face: a thin, careful, pale young face with a long jaw, level dark eyes, narrow brows, a thin set mouth, a slow considering look; about twenty-two. Hair: dark brown, parted and tied back in a short tail, plain. A few strands have escaped the tail and hang over his temple. Body: tall, narrow, held tightly, careful. He sits very upright on a stone with his knees together and his left hand steadying his right wrist. Clothing: a neat travel robe of dark green-brown cotton, a high collar, narrow sleeves, a leather belt, a small satchel strap across the chest; clean and well mended. Hands and objects: the right hand holding a brush whose tip trembles; in the left a letter wrapped in oilcloth and tied with wax string; a small herb pouch at the belt. Background: a shallow ford, grey water, reeds, a dusk sky, blurred. On the far bank a line of poplars and a faint lantern on a ferry post, with the water running pewter-grey between. Light: cool dusk light from the upper left. The last blue light of dusk gives a cold edge to his forehead and the paper. Expression: careful, slow, cold. A faint brown-green Wood hint at the pouch. Palette: green-brown, dusk grey, a little ink black.

people.imagined: The outer gate in winter. A fur-seller's daughter in a pink robe worn thin at the cuffs, a smile on her face, tucks a letter into her sleeve and does not look at the person she has just betrayed.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a gate in winter with a bundle of furs on her arm, smiling warmly, slipping a letter into her sleeve. Face: a soft, round, pretty face with rosy cheeks, large friendly brown eyes, a button nose, a small curved mouth; the smile just a shade too steady; about thirty. Hair: dark brown, in two braids pinned up with pink ribbons. Body: plump, soft, brisk. Her shoulders are rounded forward and her weight rests on one foot, a warm inviting lean toward the person she is speaking to. Clothing: a robe of pink silk, pale and soft at the cuffs, cross collar, tied with a darker rose sash, long sleeves; over it a short white fur jacket; fur hairs clinging to every sleeve. Hands and objects: a bundle of white and silver furs on the right arm; the left hand sliding a folded paper into the sleeve; a small pink silk purse. On the left forearm the pink sleeve has a small cuff seam re-stitched in a slightly different shade, and a white fur hair lies across the back of her hand. Background: Behind her the gate posts carry a thin crust of ice and a few icicles, a wooden bucket stands by the wall, and a woman in grey passes at a distance. Light: cold white winter light from the upper left, the pink glowing. Snow glare fills the frame and makes her skin look pale and pink. Expression: pleasant, warm, deceitful. A very faint dark-teal Water shadow in the folded sleeve. Palette: pink, fur white, winter grey.

people.imagined: A wet street at night in Thu Trì. He whistles through his teeth, looking up at a window, his eyes resting on the neck of a stranger passing in the lane, reckoning a price.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a rainy street whistling through his teeth, his eyes resting on a passerby's throat out of frame. Face: a thin, sharp-featured boy's face with a long narrow nose, small bright black eyes with an unblinking flatness, pale lips pursed to whistle, a thin chin; about eighteen. Hair: black, wet, plastered across the forehead. Body: thin, quick, hands in his sleeves, a street boy's slouch. His shoulders are hunched against the rain and his weight is on the back foot, a loose ready slouch like a cat. Clothing: a dark red-brown jacket of good cotton with a high collar, clean, over dark trousers a little too big, and a cord belt. Hands and objects: one hand hidden in its sleeve, the other holding a paper lantern with a plain round face of dull yellow and a single black rib showing, a thin line of rainwater running down its handle; the small bronze bell at his belt is wrapped in cloth. Background: a narrow wet lane of dark inns, a hung lantern, blurred. Doors with lit paper windows line the lane, one of them half open on a dim room, and a dog sleeps under an awning. Light: lantern from the lower left, a yellow reflection on the wet stones. The puddles reflect the lantern's yellow in long wobbling streaks. Expression: flat, calculating, a little bored. A faint steel-grey Metal hint at the bell. Palette: soot, russet, lamp-gold.

people.imagined: Dawn on the peak, a young man with a broom, sweeping the same stone step he has swept every morning, in a duellist's stance he cannot help. A pale scar like a drawn string goes round his neck.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a stone step on a cliff he sweeps with a long broom, but his feet are in a duellist's stance. Face (most important: a pale scar round the neck like a drawn string): a lean, honest, hard young face with a strong chin, level dark eyes, straight brows, a wide plain mouth; a pale, thin scar circling the whole neck like a string, clear above the collar; about twenty-four. Hair: black, short and unevenly cut. Body: lean, strong, a duellist's balance, the broom held like a sword. Clothing: a short coat of grey-brown cloth with a high collar, a belt, trousers, clean and neat; the sleeves tied back. Hands and objects: both hands on a long broom of twigs, the grip like a sword hilt; a long plain sabre in a black scabbard leaning on the wall beside him. Background: a cold stone step, a cliff edge, a pink dawn sky, blurred. Light: cold pink dawn from the upper left. The first sun lights the pale string-scar round his neck like a drawn thread of silver. Expression: honest, dogged, humble. A faint cold grey-silver Metal hint on the scabbard. Palette: iron grey, dawn pink, stone.

people.imagined: At a desert well before a crossing. She drinks from a small cup and lifts her face to the dawn, her red-rimmed eyes unable to close and her lips cracked white, ready to ride three days without sleep.
people.subject: The moment: at a well at dawn she lowers a small cup from her lips and looks wildly up, eyes wide. Face (most important: red-rimmed eyes and white-cracked lips): a sun-dark, wiry, wide-cheeked face, round dark eyes with red rims that never quite close, lips cracked into white seams, a strong nose, a streak of dust; about thirty. Hair: black, tied back in a twist under a sand-coloured scarf, a loose strand. Fine grey dust powders the scarf and her eyebrows. Body: lean, hard, jittery, a rider's bowed stance. She has one knee bent and her upper body twisted to the camel, with the loose over-alert stance of someone who has not slept. Clothing: a short jacket of sand-brown leather-trimmed cloth, a scarf round the neck, wide riding trousers and a red sash; clean and sound. Hands and objects: a small dark cup in the right hand with a red dribble at the rim; the left on the rope of a camel at her side. Background: a dry well, the pale desert and a camel, a rising sun, blurred. Several camels kneel in a ring around a stone-curbed well, with sacks and water-skins piled between them, and far off the first line of red dunes. Light: cold gold dawn from the left. The rising sun lies low across the sand and throws long violet shadows from each camel. Expression: wide-eyed, hungry, over-bright. A faint red Fire hint in the cup. Palette: sand, red, dust grey.

people.imagined: The bottom of a half-dug well in Đàm Ảnh Thành, mud to the elbow. He looks up the shaft at the circle of sky, wiping his palm, believing the old man he digs for is only a water-finder.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a half-dug well, he looks up the shaft toward a circle of sky and wipes mud on his thigh. Face: a plain, round, honest young face, earnest brown eyes, thick brows, a short nose, a wide mouth ready to smile, grey earth smeared on one cheek; about twenty-five. Hair: black, cropped, covered in grey dust. Grey earth has dried in the hair like a cap. Body: stocky, strong-armed, earth-grey from fingertips to elbows. He stands with feet apart on the muddy floor and his head tipped back, hands loose at his sides, shoulders thick. Clothing: a short sleeveless jerkin of plain undyed cloth over a clean cotton shirt, rolled trousers, a rope belt; clean at the collar. Hands and objects: forearms earth-grey to the elbow; a ring-shaped rope scar round the right palm clearly visible as he raises it; a short spade leaning on the wall and a small cloth flag tied to it. Background: a circular wall of earth and stone, wet, a round bright sky above, blurred. Rope and wooden rungs climb the wall of the shaft, a bucket hangs on a rope from above, and a little water gleams at the bottom around his boots. Light: a bright shaft from above, upper left, the rest dark and damp. The beam from above makes a hard bright circle at his feet and a soft gold glow up his front. Expression: honest, hardworking, trusting. A faint teal-blue Water glint on the wet wall. Palette: earth grey, wet brown, sky blue.

people.imagined: A river landing in the afternoon. She stands at the water's edge with her thumb held up to the light, so a fleck of gold shows in its web, thinking of the woman in the red robe and how she would stand.
people.subject: The moment: at a river's edge she lifts her thumb to the light with a look of deep concentration and daydream. Face: a young, tanned, narrow face with high cheekbones, big dark ambitious eyes, thick straight brows, a wide mouth set proud; a smear of river mud on the chin; about twenty. Hair: black, in two thick braids tied with red string. Body: slim, strong, straight-backed, a gold-washer's shoulders. She stands in the shallows with one foot in front of the other, hip cocked, her head tilted back to follow the thumb. Clothing: a short robe of plain dark-blue cotton, clean, cross collar, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a cord belt, trousers rolled to the knee; bare feet in the shallows. Hands and objects: the thumb held up with a small bright fleck of gold visible in its web; in the left a shallow wooden washing pan full of dark sand with a few glints; a small piece of red cloth tied at the wrist. The shallow wooden pan is dark with wet sand and bears the flat scrape-marks of years of washing. Background: a wide brown river, reeds and a landing stage, blurred. A line of small boats and fishermen on the far bank, a heron among the reeds, and a hazy brown line of hills. Light: low golden afternoon light from the upper left, glitter on water. Low light catches in the fleck of gold on her thumb and makes it flare like a tiny star. Expression: dreamy, determined, proud. A faint pale-blue Water hint. Palette: river brown, gold, indigo.
